description: ACN Bank conversational AI agent - voice primary, webchat, WhatsApp. 31-agent GECX hierarchy covering banking, products, and service journeys. PRD v2.4.

en-CA.instruction:
# Audio Profile
Voice: Iapetus. Rate: 1.05x. Channel: live bidi webchat voice, telephony (PSTN/VoIP), WhatsApp TTS. Locale: Canadian English (en-CA).

# Director's note
You are an experienced ACN Bank advisor talking to someone across a desk, not reading them a policy document. Speak the way a good banker actually speaks: warm, unhurried, genuinely interested in the person's situation.

Use contractions -- "you'll", "let's", "that's". Vary your rhythm; short sentences after long ones. Let small natural fillers land where a real person would pause to think -- "right", "okay", "so" -- but sparingly, never as a verbal tic.

When you hand over a number, slow down and let it sit. Money deserves a beat of silence around it. When the customer gives you something personal -- an income, a worry about affording a place -- acknowledge it like a human before you move on.

Stay plain-spoken. No corporate throat-clearing, no "I'd be happy to assist you with that today". Say "sure" or "of course" and get on with it. Confident, never salesy; you are not pushing a product, you are helping someone decide.

For errors or bad news, soften and slow slightly -- steady, not apologetic. During authentication, keep an easy unhurried pace that takes the anxiety out of it. Barge-in is expected in live conversation: if the customer starts talking, stop cleanly and listen.

fr-CA.instruction:
# Audio Profile
Voix : Iapetus. Cadence : 1.05x. Canal : clavardage web vocal en direct (bidi), téléphonie (RTPC/VoIP), WhatsApp TTS. Paramètres régionaux : français canadien (fr-CA).

# Director's note
Vous êtes un conseiller chevronné de Banque ACN qui parle à quelqu'un assis en face de vous, et non quelqu'un qui lit une politique à voix haute. Parlez comme un bon conseiller parle vraiment : chaleureux, posé, sincèrement intéressé par la situation de la personne.

Employez un registre naturel et familier, sans relâchement. Variez le rythme : des phrases courtes après les longues. Laissez tomber de petites marques d'hésitation là où une vraie personne réfléchirait -- « bon », « d'accord », « alors » -- mais avec parcimonie, jamais comme un tic.

Quand vous annoncez un montant, ralentissez et laissez-le résonner. L'argent mérite un temps de silence autour de lui. Quand le client vous confie quelque chose de personnel -- un revenu, une inquiétude sur sa capacité à payer -- accueillez-le humainement avant de poursuivre.

Restez simple et direct. Pas de formules creuses, pas de « je serais ravi de vous assister aujourd'hui ». Dites « bien sûr » et passez à l'action. Confiant, jamais vendeur : vous ne poussez pas un produit, vous aidez quelqu'un à décider.

En cas d'erreur ou de mauvaise nouvelle, adoucissez et ralentissez légèrement -- calme, sans vous excuser. Pendant l'authentification, gardez un rythme tranquille qui désamorce l'anxiété. L'interruption fait partie de la conversation en direct : si le client se met à parler, arrêtez-vous net et écoutez.

variableDeclarations.name: active_intent
variableDeclarations.description: Current classified intent code (e.g., ACC-01, PAY-05) being handled.

variableDeclarations.name: after_hours
variableDeclarations.description: True if current time is outside business hours.

variableDeclarations.name: appointment_id
variableDeclarations.description: Branch appointment ID. Set by AT STATE_MAP from createAppointment response.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_methods
variableDeclarations.description: Auth method tracking object. Fields: l1_method, l2_method, step_up_otp_id. Set by M5 during auth flows.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_state
variableDeclarations.description: Authentication state. Fields: level (0-3), mode, locked, expires_at, last_activity, step_up_required, step_up_reason, step_up_action_hash, step_up_valid_until, otp_request_id, otp_attempts, pin_attempts. Set by AT STATE_MAP and BA/BT callbacks.

variableDeclarations.name: card_id
variableDeclarations.description: Card document ID in context for card management operations. Set by M2.3 / M4.2.

variableDeclarations.name: card_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of the card in context. Set by M2.3 / M4.2 for display.

variableDeclarations.name: cdic_disclosed
variableDeclarations.description: True once CDIC disclosure has been delivered this session.

variableDeclarations.name: channel
variableDeclarations.description: Detected channel: voice | webchat | whatsapp. Locked after turn 1.

variableDeclarations.name: channel_locked
variableDeclarations.description: True after channel detection on turn 1. Guards BA-1 re-run.

variableDeclarations.name: cie_context
variableDeclarations.description: Customer Intelligence Engine context. Fields: loaded, loaded_at, life_stage, next_best_action, nba_shown, nba_suppressed, open_applications, credit_profile_band, spending_top_categories, product_holdings. Set by AT STATE_MAP from getCustomerSegment / getNextBestActions.

variableDeclarations.name: completed_actions
variableDeclarations.description: JSON-serialized list of successfully completed actions this session.

variableDeclarations.name: csat
variableDeclarations.description: CSAT tracking object. Fields: offered (bool), rating (0-5). Set by M0 at session end.

variableDeclarations.name: current_agent
variableDeclarations.description: Resource name of the agent currently in control. Updated by callback on every transfer.

variableDeclarations.name: current_hub
variableDeclarations.description: Currently active hub agent: M2 | M3 | M4 | empty. Set by callback on transfer.

variableDeclarations.name: customer_display_name
variableDeclarations.description: Customer preferred display name. Set by BA-5 passive lookup or M5 after getCustomer.

variableDeclarations.name: customer_id
variableDeclarations.description: Trusted Firestore customer document ID. Empty at L0. Set exclusively by M5.

variableDeclarations.name: customer_profile
variableDeclarations.description: Customer identity and profile. Fields: id (kept flat), display_name, first_name, last_name, email_masked, phone_masked, segment, since_year, marketing_opt_out, vulnerable_flag, preferred_language, inject_preferred_name, identified_by. Set by AT STATE_MAP from getCustomer / identify_customer.

variableDeclarations.name: degraded_toolsets
variableDeclarations.description: JSON list of toolsets currently in degraded/read-only mode. Set by AT-7 on repeated system_error.

variableDeclarations.name: device_type
variableDeclarations.description: Device type from frontend: desktop | mobile_web | ios_app | android_app | phone.

variableDeclarations.name: disclosures_delivered
variableDeclarations.description: JSON-serialized list of verbatim copy keys delivered this session.

variableDeclarations.name: dispute_rights_disclosed
variableDeclarations.description: True once dispute rights disclosure has been delivered.

variableDeclarations.name: dtmf_enabled
variableDeclarations.description: True during PIN/OTP/SIN collection on voice.

variableDeclarations.name: escalation_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Reason for deterministic escalation routing to M4.3.

variableDeclarations.name: financial_advice_disclaimer_shown
variableDeclarations.description: True once financial advice disclaimer has been shown this session.

variableDeclarations.name: fraud_suspected
variableDeclarations.description: True when fraud fast-path is active. Set by callback BM-3. Never override.

variableDeclarations.name: identified_by
variableDeclarations.description: Method used to identify the customer: caller_id | wa_id | phone | webchat_sso.

variableDeclarations.name: inject_preferred_name
variableDeclarations.description: Flag: true when model should greet customer by preferred name on this turn.

variableDeclarations.name: intent_confidence
variableDeclarations.description: Intent classification confidence score (0.0 to 1.0). Set by callback after classification.

variableDeclarations.name: journey_context
variableDeclarations.description: JSON-serialized current journey state for active workflow.

variableDeclarations.name: journey_id
variableDeclarations.description: Active journey identifier string. Set by specialist agent at journey start.

variableDeclarations.name: journey_resume_offered
variableDeclarations.description: True once journey resumption prompt has been delivered this session.

variableDeclarations.name: journey_step
variableDeclarations.description: Named step within the active journey (e.g., kyc_pending, verification, decision). Set by specialist.

variableDeclarations.name: last_quick_actions
variableDeclarations.description: JSON-serialized last quick_actions chips shown (webchat).

variableDeclarations.name: last_widget_type
variableDeclarations.description: Type of last widget emitted in webchat channel (for sequence enforcement).

variableDeclarations.name: live_agent_requested
variableDeclarations.description: True if customer has explicitly requested a live agent.

variableDeclarations.name: mock_mode
variableDeclarations.description: True enables deterministic mock fixture responses instead of live API calls.

variableDeclarations.name: nsf_reversal_eligible
variableDeclarations.description: Computed from NSF history (max 1 reversal/12 months); NEVER override. Writer: M2.9

variableDeclarations.name: nudge_allowed
variableDeclarations.description: True when NBA nudge may be surfaced this turn. Set by acn_callbacks before_model.

variableDeclarations.name: overdraft_enabled
variableDeclarations.description: Current overdraft protection state. Writer: M2.9

variableDeclarations.name: pad_cancel_id
variableDeclarations.description: PAD authorization reference ID set after cancelPAD succeeds. Read in AT-PAD-rights callback.

variableDeclarations.name: pending_intent_queue
variableDeclarations.description: JSON-serialized list of queued intents for multi-intent handling. Max 5.

variableDeclarations.name: pipeda_disclosed
variableDeclarations.description: True once PIPEDA disclosure copy delivered.

variableDeclarations.name: previous_agent
variableDeclarations.description: Resource name of the prior agent, for return-after-subtask flows.

variableDeclarations.name: provisional_credit_eligible
variableDeclarations.description: True if dispute meets provisional credit policy (<=CAD5000, within 120 days, <=2 disputes in 12 months).

variableDeclarations.name: rewards_balance_points
variableDeclarations.description: Rewards points balance. Set by AT STATE_MAP from getRewardsBalance response.

variableDeclarations.name: routing_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Reason for current routing decision: classified | fast_path_fraud | fast_path_lost_stolen | resume | nudge_accept | escalation.

variableDeclarations.name: session_counters
variableDeclarations.description: Session behaviour counters. Fields: turns, no_match, no_input, small_talk, retry_strikes, tool_errors, validation_errors, injection_attempts, disambiguation. Incremented by BA/BM/AM/AT callbacks.

variableDeclarations.name: session_language_locked
variableDeclarations.description: True once language is locked on first utterance.

variableDeclarations.name: stop_payment_id
variableDeclarations.description: Set on successful stop-payment; used in confirmation receipt. Writer: M2.7

variableDeclarations.name: telephony-caller-id
variableDeclarations.description: Caller phone number injected by the telephony platform at call start (dashes). Read-only in callbacks — use telephony_caller_id (bridged) for application logic.

variableDeclarations.name: telephony_caller_id
variableDeclarations.description: Caller ID from telephony platform. Presence signals voice channel.

variableDeclarations.name: transaction_context
variableDeclarations.description: Active transaction state. Fields: awaiting_confirmation, idempotency_key, wire_disclosure_ack, fintrac_check_status, status, transaction_id, confirmation_payload_hash, fx_currency_pair, fx_rate_quoted. Set by BT/AT callbacks during money-movement flows.

variableDeclarations.name: wa_id_linked
variableDeclarations.description: True when a first-time WhatsApp user was identified this session and wa_id was linked to their profile.

variableDeclarations.name: whatsapp_wa_id
variableDeclarations.description: WhatsApp account ID (wa_id) set by WhatsApp connector. Presence signals WhatsApp channel.

variableDeclarations.name: widgets_enabled
variableDeclarations.description: True only for webchat channel.
